# Kshetej Sareen Studios

> Independent photographer with studios in New Delhi, Gurgaon and Bangalore, available in Hyderabad. Food & beverage, architectural and interior, portrait, corporate and motion work. Clients include Taj, The Leela, Six Senses, JW Marriott and Jumeirah; editorial work in Architectural Digest.

## About

Kshetej Sareen is an independent photographer and visual director, trained as an architect, working from studios on MG Road (New Delhi), Phase 1 (Gurgaon) and Richmond Town (Bangalore), and travelling for commissions in Hyderabad and beyond. The studio specialises in editorial and commercial photography across five disciplines: culinary and food & beverage, interior and architectural spaces, portrait and corporate work, still life and objects, and motion direction.

Available for commission and print sales. Pricing on request, scoped per project.
Contact: info@kshetejsareen.com
